title: US Ambassador and Huckabee Press Israel to Protect West Bank Palestinians from Settler Violence
detail: US Ambassador to Israel and Mike Huckabee both publicly pressured Israel to protect West Bank Palestinians from settler violence. The ambassador called ongoing attacks an 'act of terror that cannot continue,' following weeks of West Bank unrest including settler raids, beatings, and IDF-facilitated incidents that left multiple Palestinians wounded.

title: Israeli Strike on Vehicle Kills Father and 8-Year-Old Daughter in Western Gaza City; Two More Killed Elsewhere
detail: An Israeli strike on a vehicle in western Gaza City on Sunday, September 6, 2026 killed Youssef Akila and his 8-year-old daughter Wafaa and wounded six others, according to Mohamed Abu Selmia, director of Al-Shifa Hospital. An Israeli military spokesperson said forces had targeted a Hamas militant and were still assessing the strike's results. Separately the same day, a strike near a Gaza City telecommunications facility killed a man, and an Israeli tank fired on a school sheltering displaced families, killing a 3-year-old boy. The October 2025 US-backed ceasefire has curtailed major combat but not Israeli strikes, which the military says target Hamas and other militants; Gaza health authorities say more than 1,300 Palestinians (1,344 per the most recent count) have been killed since the ceasefire took effect, against four Israeli soldiers.
